name: Mama ni Oshioki ~Boku Mou Gaman Dekinai~
original_name: ママにおしおき～ボクもう我慢できない～
source:
Main character is a male student living in a dormitory. This winter he returns to his estate for the first time after his father went missing. He loves his mother tenderly and gets aroused by her embrace. What kind of winter vacation will he have?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
